post_title: Pay asking, or make a smart offer? The comps say it's 9% high.
caption:
Asking $340K. The comps say it's worth less. 🏠

Overpaying doesn't hurt once. It hurts every month for 30 years. Head to head:

• Price: $340K vs $315K.
• Cash to close: $7,000 less up front.
• Payment: $125 less every month.
• Cash flow: −$136 vs +$11 a month.

A clean sweep, and about $45,000 saved over the loan.
